describe.description: Read the monitor: source, roster, nominal band, open session. Says if readings are simulated.

presence.description: Occupants per module. Call before proposing a test on a volume.

monitor_start.description: Open monitoring over the people in these modules for a procedure. Refused if a session is open or the modules are empty.

monitor_stop.description: Close the session. Returns the record.

report.description: Gateway relays one strap reading: bpm and beat intervals.

state.description: Monitored subjects: last rate, band, status (nominal, out-of-band, signal-lost).

verdict.description: One line for an abort list. This slot stops nothing itself.

move.description: Put a subject in a module. Scenario control.
